description: It will end in a churchyard

participation.context: Gave the friar, took the churchyard, and refused to carry the chronicle back.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Approved the friar, withdrew it, measured the loaf, and kept the cat unapproved.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Named where the cat had moved, and kept the cloth on the chronicle.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

relations.note: a marriage without the fathers ends in the yard
relations.quote: it will end in a churchyard.

story.body: You told the marriage. She took the approval back. You left Gib on Brooke and the chronicle under the cloth.

title: Heard Mistress Ansell say the friar ends in a churchyard
